\documentclass[12pt]{article}
\usepackage{pmmeta}
\pmcanonicalname{ClosedSubsetComplete}
\pmtitle{a closed subset of a complete metric space is complete}
\pmtype{Result}
\pmclassification{msc}{54E50}
\endmetadata
\begin{document}
Let $X$ be a complete metric space, and let $Y \subseteq X$ be a closed subset of $X$. Then $Y$ is complete.

{\bf Proof}
Let $\{ y_n \}$ be a Cauchy sequence in $Y$.
